\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{109}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Type definition}
Using an allocatable array eliminates the need for initializer and/or
finalizer.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{110}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\endmoddef
  public :: pdg_array_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{111}\moddef{PDG arrays: types}\endmoddef
  type :: pdg_array_t
     private
     integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: pdg
   contains
   \LA{}PDG arrays: pdg array: TBP\RA{}
  end type pdg_array_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{112}Output
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{113}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: pdg_array_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{114}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg array: TBP}\endmoddef
  procedure :: write => pdg_array_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{115}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\endmoddef
  subroutine pdg_array_write (aval, unit)
    class(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    integer :: u, i
    u = given_output_unit (unit);  if (u < 0)  return
    write (u, "(A)", advance="no")  "PDG("
    if (allocated (aval%pdg)) then
       do i = 1, size (aval%pdg)
          if (i > 1)  write (u, "(A)", advance="no")  ", "
          write (u, "(I0)", advance="no")  aval%pdg(i)
       end do
    end if
    write (u, "(A)", advance="no")  ")"
  end subroutine pdg_array_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{116}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Basic operations}
Assignment.  We define assignment from and to an integer array.
Note that the integer array, if it is the l.h.s., must be declared
allocatable by the caller.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{117}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: assignment(=)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{118}\moddef{PDG arrays: interfaces}\endmoddef
  interface assignment(=)
     module procedure pdg_array_from_int_array
     module procedure pdg_array_from_int
     module procedure int_array_from_pdg_array
  end interface

\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{119}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_array_from_int_array (aval, iarray)
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(out) :: aval
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: iarray
    allocate (aval%pdg (size (iarray)))
    aval%pdg = iarray
  end subroutine pdg_array_from_int_array

  elemental subroutine pdg_array_from_int (aval, int)
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(out) :: aval
    integer, intent(in) :: int
    allocate (aval%pdg (1))
    aval%pdg = int
  end subroutine pdg_array_from_int

  subroutine int_array_from_pdg_array (iarray, aval)
    integer, dimension(:), allocatable, intent(out) :: iarray
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval
    if (allocated (aval%pdg)) then
       allocate (iarray (size (aval%pdg)))
       iarray = aval%pdg
    else
       allocate (iarray (0))
    end if
  end subroutine int_array_from_pdg_array

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{120}Allocate space for a PDG array
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{121}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: pdg_array_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{122}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
   subroutine pdg_array_init (aval, n_elements)
     type(pdg_array_t), intent(inout) :: aval
     integer, intent(in) :: n_elements
     allocate(aval%pdg(n_elements))
   end subroutine pdg_array_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{123}Deallocate a previously allocated pdg array
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{124}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: pdg_array_delete
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{125}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_array_delete (aval)
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(inout) :: aval
    if (allocated (aval%pdg)) deallocate (aval%pdg)
  end subroutine pdg_array_delete

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{126}Merge two pdg arrays, i.e. append a particle string to another leaving out doublettes
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{127}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: pdg_array_merge
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{128}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_array_merge (aval1, aval2)
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(inout) :: aval1
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval2
    type(pdg_array_t) :: aval
    if (allocated (aval1%pdg) .and. allocated (aval2%pdg)) then
      if (.not. any (aval1%pdg == aval2%pdg)) aval = aval1 // aval2
    else if (allocated (aval1%pdg)) then
      aval = aval1
    else if (allocated (aval2%pdg)) then
      aval = aval2
    end if
    call pdg_array_delete (aval1)
    aval1 = aval%pdg
  end subroutine pdg_array_merge

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{129}Length of the array.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{130}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: pdg_array_get_length
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{131}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg array: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: get_length => pdg_array_get_length
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{132}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental function pdg_array_get_length (aval) result (n)
    class(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval
    integer :: n
    if (allocated (aval%pdg)) then
       n = size (aval%pdg)
    else
       n = 0
    end if
  end function pdg_array_get_length

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{133}Return the element with index i.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{134}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: pdg_array_get
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{135}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg array: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: get => pdg_array_get
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{136}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental function pdg_array_get (aval, i) result (pdg)
    class(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval
    integer, intent(in), optional :: i
    integer :: pdg
    if (present (i)) then
       pdg = aval%pdg(i)
    else 
       pdg = aval%pdg(1)
    end if
  end function pdg_array_get

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{137}Explicitly set the element with index i.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{138}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg array: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: set => pdg_array_set
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{139}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_array_set (aval, i, pdg)
    class(pdg_array_t), intent(inout) :: aval
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg
    aval%pdg(i) = pdg
  end subroutine pdg_array_set

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{140}Replace element with index {\tt{}i} by a new array of elements.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{141}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: pdg_array_replace
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{142}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg array: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: replace => pdg_array_replace
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{143}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function pdg_array_replace (aval, i, pdg_new) result (aval_new)
    class(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: pdg_new
    type(pdg_array_t) :: aval_new
    integer :: n, l
    n = size (aval%pdg)
    l = size (pdg_new)
    allocate (aval_new%pdg (n + l - 1))
    aval_new%pdg(:i-1) = aval%pdg(:i-1)
    aval_new%pdg(i:i+l-1) = pdg_new
    aval_new%pdg(i+l:) = aval%pdg(i+1:)
  end function pdg_array_replace
    
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{144}Concatenate two PDG arrays
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{145}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: operator(//)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{146}\moddef{PDG arrays: interfaces}\plusendmoddef
  interface operator(//)
     module procedure concat_pdg_arrays
  end interface

\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{147}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function concat_pdg_arrays (aval1, aval2) result (aval)
    type(pdg_array_t) :: aval
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval1, aval2
    integer :: n1, n2
    if (allocated (aval1%pdg) .and. allocated (aval2%pdg)) then
       n1 = size (aval1%pdg)
       n2 = size (aval2%pdg)
       allocate (aval%pdg (n1 + n2))
       aval%pdg(:n1) = aval1%pdg
       aval%pdg(n1+1:) = aval2%pdg
    else if (allocated (aval1%pdg)) then
       aval = aval1
    else if (allocated (aval2%pdg)) then
       aval = aval2
    end if
  end function concat_pdg_arrays

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{148}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Matching}
A PDG array matches a given PDG code if the code is present within the
array.  If either one is zero (UNDEFINED), the match also succeeds.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{149}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: operator(.match.)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{150}\moddef{PDG arrays: interfaces}\plusendmoddef
  interface operator(.match.)
     module procedure pdg_array_match_integer
     module procedure pdg_array_match_pdg_array
  end interface

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{151}Match a single code against the array.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{152}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental function pdg_array_match_integer (aval, pdg) result (flag)
    logical :: flag
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg
    if (allocated (aval%pdg)) then
       flag = pdg == UNDEFINED &
            .or. any (aval%pdg == UNDEFINED) &
            .or. any (aval%pdg == pdg)
    else
       flag = .false.
    end if
  end function pdg_array_match_integer

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{153}Check if the pdg-number corresponds to a quark
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{154}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: is_quark
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{155}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function is_quark (pdg_nr) result(res)
      integer, intent(in) :: pdg_nr
      logical :: res
      if (pdg_nr >= 1 .and. pdg_nr <= 6) then 
        res = .true.
      else
        res = .false.
      end if
   end function is_quark

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{156}Check if pdg-number corresponds to a gluon
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{157}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: is_gluon
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{158}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
   function is_gluon (pdg_nr) result(res)
     integer, intent(in) :: pdg_nr
     logical :: res
     if (pdg_nr == 21) then
       res = .true.
     else
       res = .false.
     end if
   end function is_gluon

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{159}% Check if the pdg-number corresponds to a lepton
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{160}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: is_lepton
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{161}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function is_lepton (pdg_nr) result(res)
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg_nr
    logical :: res
    if (pdg_nr >= 11 .and. pdg_nr <= 16) then
      res = .true.
    else
      res = .false.
    end if
  end function is_lepton

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{162}Check if the pdg-number corresponds to a massless vector boson
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{163}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: is_massless_vector
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{164}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function is_massless_vector (pdg_nr) result (res)
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg_nr
    logical :: res
    if (pdg_nr == 21 .or. pdg_nr == 22) then
      res = .true.
    else
      res = .false.
    end if
  end function is_massless_vector

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{165}Check if pdg-number corresponds to a massive vector boson
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{166}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: is_massive_vector
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{167}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function is_massive_vector (pdg_nr) result (res)
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg_nr
    logical :: res
    if (pdg_nr == 23 .or. pdg_nr == 24) then
      res = .true.
    else
      res = .false.
    end if
  end function is_massive_vector

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{168}Check if particle is strongly interacting
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{169}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: is_qcd_particle
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{170}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function is_qcd_particle (pdg_nr) result (res)
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg_nr
    logical :: res
    res = .false.
    if (is_quark (abs (pdg_nr)) .or. is_gluon (pdg_nr)) &
      res = .true.
  end function is_qcd_particle

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{171}Match two arrays.  Succeeds if any pair of entries matches.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{172}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function pdg_array_match_pdg_array (aval1, aval2) result (flag)
    logical :: flag
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval1, aval2
    if (allocated (aval1%pdg) .and. allocated (aval2%pdg)) then
       flag = any (aval1 .match. aval2%pdg)
    else
       flag = .false.
    end if
  end function pdg_array_match_pdg_array

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{173}Comparison.  Here, we take the PDG arrays as-is, assuming that they
are sorted.

The ordering is a bit odd: first, we look only at the absolute values
of the PDG codes.  If they all match, the particle comes before the
antiparticle, scanning from left to right.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{174}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: operator(<)
  public :: operator(>)
  public :: operator(<=)
  public :: operator(>=)
  public :: operator(==)
  public :: operator(/=)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{175}\moddef{PDG arrays: interfaces}\plusendmoddef
  interface operator(<)
     module procedure pdg_array_lt
  end interface
  interface operator(>)
     module procedure pdg_array_gt
  end interface
  interface operator(<=)
     module procedure pdg_array_le
  end interface
  interface operator(>=)
     module procedure pdg_array_ge
  end interface
  interface operator(==)
     module procedure pdg_array_eq
  end interface
  interface operator(/=)
     module procedure pdg_array_ne
  end interface

\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{176}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental function pdg_array_lt (aval1, aval2) result (flag)
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval1, aval2
    logical :: flag
    integer :: i
    if (size (aval1%pdg) /= size (aval2%pdg)) then
       flag = size (aval1%pdg) < size (aval2%pdg)
    else
       do i = 1, size (aval1%pdg)
          if (abs (aval1%pdg(i)) /= abs (aval2%pdg(i))) then
             flag = abs (aval1%pdg(i)) < abs (aval2%pdg(i))
             return
          end if
       end do
       do i = 1, size (aval1%pdg)
          if (aval1%pdg(i) /= aval2%pdg(i)) then
             flag = aval1%pdg(i) > aval2%pdg(i)
             return
          end if
       end do
       flag = .false.
    end if
  end function pdg_array_lt

  elemental function pdg_array_gt (aval1, aval2) result (flag)
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval1, aval2
    logical :: flag
    flag = .not. (aval1 < aval2 .or. aval1 == aval2)
  end function pdg_array_gt

  elemental function pdg_array_le (aval1, aval2) result (flag)
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval1, aval2
    logical :: flag
    flag = aval1 < aval2 .or. aval1 == aval2
  end function pdg_array_le

  elemental function pdg_array_ge (aval1, aval2) result (flag)
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval1, aval2
    logical :: flag
    flag = .not. (aval1 < aval2)
  end function pdg_array_ge

  elemental function pdg_array_eq (aval1, aval2) result (flag)
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval1, aval2
    logical :: flag
    if (size (aval1%pdg) /= size (aval2%pdg)) then
       flag = .false.
    else
       flag = all (aval1%pdg == aval2%pdg)
    end if
  end function pdg_array_eq

  elemental function pdg_array_ne (aval1, aval2) result (flag)
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval1, aval2
    logical :: flag
    flag = .not. (aval1 == aval2)
  end function pdg_array_ne

\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{177}Equivalence.  Two PDG arrays are equivalent if either one contains
{\tt{}UNDEFINED} or if each element of array 1 is present in array 2, and
vice versa.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{178}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: operator(.eqv.)
  public :: operator(.neqv.)
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{179}\moddef{PDG arrays: interfaces}\plusendmoddef
  interface operator(.eqv.)
     module procedure pdg_array_equivalent
  end interface
  interface operator(.neqv.)
     module procedure pdg_array_inequivalent
  end interface

\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{180}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental function pdg_array_equivalent (aval1, aval2) result (eq)
    logical :: eq
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval1, aval2
    logical, dimension(:), allocatable :: match1, match2
    integer :: i
    if (allocated (aval1%pdg) .and. allocated (aval2%pdg)) then
       eq = any (aval1%pdg == UNDEFINED) &
            .or. any (aval2%pdg == UNDEFINED)
       if (.not. eq) then
          allocate (match1 (size (aval1%pdg)))
          allocate (match2 (size (aval2%pdg)))
          match1 = .false.
          match2 = .false.
          do i = 1, size (aval1%pdg)
             match2 = match2 .or. aval1%pdg(i) == aval2%pdg
          end do
          do i = 1, size (aval2%pdg)
             match1 = match1 .or. aval2%pdg(i) == aval1%pdg
          end do
          eq = all (match1) .and. all (match2)
       end if
    else
       eq = .false.
    end if
  end function pdg_array_equivalent

  elemental function pdg_array_inequivalent (aval1, aval2) result (neq)
    logical :: neq
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval1, aval2
    neq = .not. pdg_array_equivalent (aval1, aval2)
  end function pdg_array_inequivalent

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{181}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Sorting}
Sort a PDG array by absolute value, particle before antiparticle.  After
sorting, we eliminate double entries.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{182}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: sort_abs
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{183}\moddef{PDG arrays: interfaces}\plusendmoddef
  interface sort_abs
     module procedure pdg_array_sort_abs
  end interface
  
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{184}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg array: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: sort_abs => pdg_array_sort_abs
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{185}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function pdg_array_sort_abs (aval1, unique) result (aval2)
    class(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval1
    logical, intent(in), optional :: unique
    type(pdg_array_t) :: aval2
    integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: tmp
    logical, dimension(:), allocatable :: mask
    integer :: i, n
    logical :: uni
    uni = .false.;  if (present (unique))  uni = unique
    n = size (aval1%pdg)
    if (uni) then
       allocate (tmp (n), mask(n))
       tmp = sort_abs (aval1%pdg)
       mask(1) = .true.
       do i = 2, n
          mask(i) = tmp(i) /= tmp(i-1)
       end do
       allocate (aval2%pdg (count (mask)))
       aval2%pdg = pack (tmp, mask)
    else
       allocate (aval2%pdg (n))
       aval2%pdg = sort_abs (aval1%pdg)
    end if
  end function pdg_array_sort_abs

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{186}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{187}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg array: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: intersect => pdg_array_intersect
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{188}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function pdg_array_intersect (aval1, match) result (aval2)
   class(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: aval1
   integer, dimension(:) :: match
   type(pdg_array_t) :: aval2
   integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: isec
   integer :: i
   isec = pack (aval1%pdg, [(any(aval1%pdg(i) == match), i=1,size(aval1%pdg))])
   aval2 = isec
  end function pdg_array_intersect 

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{189}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{190}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg array: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: search_for_particle => pdg_array_search_for_particle
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{191}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function pdg_array_search_for_particle (pdg, i_part) result (found)
    class(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: pdg
    integer, intent(in) :: i_part
    logical :: found
    found = any (pdg%pdg == i_part)
  end function pdg_array_search_for_particle

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{192}\nwdocspar
\subsection{PDG array list}
A PDG array list, or PDG list, is an array of PDG-array objects with
some convenience methods.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{193}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: pdg_list_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{194}\moddef{PDG arrays: types}\plusendmoddef
  type :: pdg_list_t
     type(pdg_array_t), dimension(:), allocatable :: a
   contains
   \LA{}PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP\RA{}
  end type pdg_list_t
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{195}Output, as a comma-separated list without advancing I/O.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{196}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\endmoddef
  procedure :: write => pdg_list_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{197}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_list_write (object, unit)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(in) :: object
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    integer :: u, i
    u = given_output_unit (unit)
    if (allocated (object%a)) then
       do i = 1, size (object%a)
          if (i > 1)  write (u, "(A)", advance="no")  ", "
          call object%a(i)%write (u)
       end do
    end if
  end subroutine pdg_list_write
    
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{198}Initialize for a certain size.  The entries are initially empty PDG arrays.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{199}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  generic :: init => pdg_list_init_size
  procedure, private :: pdg_list_init_size
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{200}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_list_init_size (pl, n)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(out) :: pl
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    allocate (pl%a (n))
  end subroutine pdg_list_init_size
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{201}Initialize with a definite array of PDG codes.  That is, each entry
in the list becomes a single-particle PDG array.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{202}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  generic :: init => pdg_list_init_int_array
  procedure, private :: pdg_list_init_int_array
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{203}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_list_init_int_array (pl, pdg)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(out) :: pl
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: pdg
    integer :: i
    allocate (pl%a (size (pdg)))
    do i = 1, size (pdg)
       pl%a(i) = pdg(i)
    end do
  end subroutine pdg_list_init_int_array
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{204}Set one of the entries.  No bounds-check.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{205}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  generic :: set => pdg_list_set_int
  generic :: set => pdg_list_set_int_array
  generic :: set => pdg_list_set_pdg_array
  procedure, private :: pdg_list_set_int
  procedure, private :: pdg_list_set_int_array
  procedure, private :: pdg_list_set_pdg_array
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{206}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_list_set_int (pl, i, pdg)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(inout) :: pl
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg
    pl%a(i) = pdg
  end subroutine pdg_list_set_int
  
  subroutine pdg_list_set_int_array (pl, i, pdg)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(inout) :: pl
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: pdg
    pl%a(i) = pdg
  end subroutine pdg_list_set_int_array
  
  subroutine pdg_list_set_pdg_array (pl, i, pa)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(inout) :: pl
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: pa
    pl%a(i) = pa
  end subroutine pdg_list_set_pdg_array
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{207}Array size, not the length of individual entries
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{208}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: get_size => pdg_list_get_size
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{209}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function pdg_list_get_size (pl) result (n)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(in) :: pl
    integer :: n
    if (allocated (pl%a)) then
       n = size (pl%a)
    else
       n = 0
    end if
  end function pdg_list_get_size
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{210}Return an entry, as a PDG array.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{211}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: get => pdg_list_get
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{212}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function pdg_list_get (pl, i) result (pa)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(in) :: pl
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    type(pdg_array_t) :: pa
    pa = pl%a(i)
  end function pdg_list_get
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{213}Check if the list entries are all either mutually disjoint or identical.
The individual entries (PDG arrays) should already be sorted, so we can test
for equality.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{214}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: is_regular => pdg_list_is_regular
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{215}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function pdg_list_is_regular (pl) result (flag)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(in) :: pl
    logical :: flag
    integer :: i, j, s
    s = pl%get_size ()
    flag = .true.
    do i = 1, s
       do j = i + 1, s
          if (pl%a(i) .match. pl%a(j)) then
             if (pl%a(i) /= pl%a(j)) then
                flag = .false.
                return
             end if
          end if
       end do
    end do
  end function pdg_list_is_regular
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{216}Sort the list.  First, each entry gets sorted, including elimination
of doublers.  Then, we sort the list, using the first member of each
PDG array as the marker.  No removal of doublers at this stage.

If {\tt{}n{\char95}in} is supplied, we do not reorder the first {\tt{}n{\char95}in} particle
entries.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{217}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: sort_abs => pdg_list_sort_abs
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{218}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function pdg_list_sort_abs (pl, n_in) result (pl_sorted)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(in) :: pl
    integer, intent(in), optional :: n_in
    type(pdg_list_t) :: pl_sorted
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(:), allocatable :: pa
    integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: pdg, map
    integer :: i, n0
    call pl_sorted%init (pl%get_size ())
    if (allocated (pl%a)) then
       allocate (pa (size (pl%a)))
       do i = 1, size (pl%a)
          pa(i) = pl%a(i)%sort_abs (unique = .true.)
       end do
       allocate (pdg (size (pa)), source = 0)
       do i = 1, size (pa)
          if (allocated (pa(i)%pdg)) then
             if (size (pa(i)%pdg) > 0) then
                pdg(i) = pa(i)%pdg(1)
             end if
          end if
       end do
       if (present (n_in)) then
          n0 = n_in
       else
          n0 = 0
       end if
       allocate (map (size (pdg)))
       map(:n0) = [(i, i = 1, n0)]
       map(n0+1:) = n0 + order_abs (pdg(n0+1:))
       do i = 1, size (pa)
          call pl_sorted%set (i, pa(map(i)))
       end do
    end if
  end function pdg_list_sort_abs
    
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{219}Compare sorted lists: equality.  The result is undefined if some entries
are not allocated.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{220}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  generic :: operator (==) => pdg_list_eq
  procedure, private :: pdg_list_eq
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{221}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function pdg_list_eq (pl1, pl2) result (flag)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(in) :: pl1, pl2
    logical :: flag
    integer :: i
    flag = .false.
    if (allocated (pl1%a) .and. allocated (pl2%a)) then
       if (size (pl1%a) == size (pl2%a)) then
          do i = 1, size (pl1%a)
             associate (a1 => pl1%a(i), a2 => pl2%a(i))
               if (allocated (a1%pdg) .and. allocated (a2%pdg)) then
                  if (size (a1%pdg) == size (a2%pdg)) then
                     if (size (a1%pdg) > 0) then
                        if (a1%pdg(1) /= a2%pdg(1)) return
                     end if
                  else
                     return
                  end if
               else
                  return
               end if
             end associate
          end do
          flag = .true.
       end if
    end if
  end function pdg_list_eq
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{222}Compare sorted lists.  The result is undefined if some entries
are not allocated.

The ordering is quite complicated.  First, a shorter list comes before
a longer list.  Comparing entry by entry, a shorter entry comes
first.  Next, we check the first PDG code within corresponding
entries.  This is compared by absolute value.  If equal, particle
comes before antiparticle.  Finally, if all is equal, the result is
false.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{223}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  generic :: operator (<) => pdg_list_lt
  procedure, private :: pdg_list_lt
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{224}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function pdg_list_lt (pl1, pl2) result (flag)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(in) :: pl1, pl2
    logical :: flag
    integer :: i
    flag = .false.
    if (allocated (pl1%a) .and. allocated (pl2%a)) then
       if (size (pl1%a) < size (pl2%a)) then
          flag = .true.;  return
       else if (size (pl1%a) > size (pl2%a)) then
          return
       else
          do i = 1, size (pl1%a)
             associate (a1 => pl1%a(i), a2 => pl2%a(i))
               if (allocated (a1%pdg) .and. allocated (a2%pdg)) then
                  if (size (a1%pdg) < size (a2%pdg)) then
                     flag = .true.;  return
                  else if (size (a1%pdg) > size (a2%pdg)) then
                     return
                  else
                     if (size (a1%pdg) > 0) then
                        if (abs (a1%pdg(1)) < abs (a2%pdg(1))) then
                           flag = .true.;  return
                        else if (abs (a1%pdg(1)) > abs (a2%pdg(1))) then
                           return
                        else if (a1%pdg(1) > 0 .and. a2%pdg(1) < 0) then
                           flag = .true.;  return
                        else if (a1%pdg(1) < 0 .and. a2%pdg(1) > 0) then
                           return
                        end if
                     end if
                  end if
               else
                  return
               end if
             end associate
          end do
          flag = .false.
       end if
    end if
  end function pdg_list_lt
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{225}Replace an entry.  In the result, the entry {\tt{}{\char35}i} is replaced by
the contents of the second argument.  The result is not sorted.

If {\tt{}n{\char95}in} is also set and {\tt{}i} is less or equal to {\tt{}n{\char95}in},
replace {\tt{}{\char35}i} only by the first entry of {\tt{}pl{\char95}insert}, and insert
the remainder after entry {\tt{}n{\char95}in}.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{226}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: replace => pdg_list_replace
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{227}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function pdg_list_replace (pl, i, pl_insert, n_in) result (pl_out)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(in) :: pl
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(in) :: pl_insert
    integer, intent(in), optional :: n_in
    type(pdg_list_t) :: pl_out
    integer :: n, n_insert, n_out, k
    n = pl%get_size ()
    n_insert = pl_insert%get_size ()
    n_out = n + n_insert - 1
    call pl_out%init (n_out)
!    if (allocated (pl%a)) then
       do k = 1, i - 1
          pl_out%a(k) = pl%a(k)
       end do
!    end if
    if (present (n_in)) then
       pl_out%a(i) = pl_insert%a(1)
       do k = i + 1, n_in
          pl_out%a(k) = pl%a(k)
       end do
       do k = 1, n_insert - 1
          pl_out%a(n_in+k) = pl_insert%a(1+k)
       end do
       do k = 1, n - n_in
          pl_out%a(n_in+k+n_insert-1) = pl%a(n_in+k)
       end do
    else
!       if (allocated (pl_insert%a)) then
          do k = 1, n_insert
             pl_out%a(i-1+k) = pl_insert%a(k)
          end do
!       end if
!       if (allocated (pl%a)) then
          do k = 1, n - i
             pl_out%a(i+n_insert-1+k) = pl%a(i+k)
          end do
       end if
!    end if
  end function pdg_list_replace
    
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{228}Replace the entries of {\tt{}pl} by the matching entries of {\tt{}pl{\char95}match}, one by
one.  This is done in-place.  If there is no match, return failure.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{229}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: match_replace => pdg_list_match_replace
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{230}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_list_match_replace (pl, pl_match, success)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(inout) :: pl
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(in) :: pl_match
    logical, intent(out) :: success
    integer :: i, j
    success = .true.
    SCAN_ENTRIES: do i = 1, size (pl%a)
       do j = 1, size (pl_match%a)
          if (pl%a(i) .match. pl_match%a(j)) then
             pl%a(i) = pl_match%a(j)
             cycle SCAN_ENTRIES
          end if
       end do
       success = .false.
       return
    end do SCAN_ENTRIES
  end subroutine pdg_list_match_replace
 
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{231}Just check if a PDG array matches any entry in the PDG list.  The second
version returns the position of the match within the list.  An optional mask
indicates the list elements that should be checked.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{232}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  generic :: operator (.match.) => pdg_list_match_pdg_array
  procedure, private :: pdg_list_match_pdg_array
  procedure :: find_match => pdg_list_find_match_pdg_array
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{233}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function pdg_list_match_pdg_array (pl, pa) result (flag)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(in) :: pl
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: pa
    logical :: flag
    flag = pl%find_match (pa) /= 0
  end function pdg_list_match_pdg_array
  
  function pdg_list_find_match_pdg_array (pl, pa, mask) result (i)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(in) :: pl
    type(pdg_array_t), intent(in) :: pa
    logical, dimension(:), intent(in), optional :: mask
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, size (pl%a)
       if (present (mask)) then
          if (.not. mask(i))  cycle
       end if
       if (pl%a(i) .match. pa)  return
    end do
    i = 0
  end function pdg_list_find_match_pdg_array
  
\eatline
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{234}Some old compilers have problems with allocatable arrays as
intent(out) or as function result, so be conservative here:
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{235}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: create_pdg_array => pdg_list_create_pdg_array
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{236}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_list_create_pdg_array (pl, pdg)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(in) :: pl
    type(pdg_array_t), dimension(:), intent(inout), allocatable :: pdg
    integer :: n_elements
    integer :: i
    associate (a => pl%a)
      n_elements = size (a)
      if (allocated (pdg))  deallocate (pdg)
      allocate (pdg (n_elements))
      do i = 1, n_elements
         pdg(i) = a(i)
      end do
    end associate
  end subroutine pdg_list_create_pdg_array

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{237}\nwdocspar
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{238}\moddef{PDG arrays: pdg list: TBP}\plusendmoddef
  procedure :: search_for_particle => pdg_list_search_for_particle
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{239}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function pdg_list_search_for_particle (pl, i_part) result (found)
    class(pdg_list_t), intent(in) :: pl
    integer, intent(in) :: i_part
    logical :: found
    integer :: i_pl
    do i_pl = 1, size (pl%a)
       found = pl%a(i_pl)%search_for_particle (i_part)
       if (found) return
    end do
  end function pdg_list_search_for_particle

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{240}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Unit tests}
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{241}\moddef{PDG arrays: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: pdg_arrays_test 
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{242}\moddef{PDG arrays: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_arrays_test (u, results)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type (test_results_t), intent(inout) :: results
  \LA{}PDG arrays: execute tests\RA{}  
  end subroutine pdg_arrays_test

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{243}Basic functionality.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{244}\moddef{PDG arrays: execute tests}\endmoddef
  call test (pdg_arrays_1, "pdg_arrays_1", &
       "create and sort PDG array", &
       u, results) 
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{245}\moddef{PDG arrays: tests}\endmoddef
  subroutine pdg_arrays_1 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u

    type(pdg_array_t) :: pa, pa1, pa2, pa3, pa4, pa5, pa6
    integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: pdg

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: pdg_arrays_1"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: create and sort PDG arrays"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Assignment"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    call pa%write (u)
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A,I0)")  "length = ", pa%get_length ()
    pdg = pa
    write (u, "(A,3(1x,I0))")  "contents = ", pdg
    
    write (u, *)
    pa = 1
    call pa%write (u)
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A,I0)")  "length = ", pa%get_length ()
    pdg = pa
    write (u, "(A,3(1x,I0))")  "contents = ", pdg
    
    write (u, *)
    pa = [1, 2, 3]
    call pa%write (u)
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A,I0)")  "length = ", pa%get_length ()
    pdg = pa
    write (u, "(A,3(1x,I0))")  "contents = ", pdg
    write (u, "(A,I0)")  "element #2 = ", pa%get (2)
    
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Replace"
    write (u, *)

    pa = pa%replace (2, [-5, 5, -7])
    call pa%write (u)
    write (u, *)
    
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Sort"
    write (u, *)

    pa = [1, -7, 3, -5, 5, 3]
    call pa%write (u)
    write (u, *)
    pa1 = pa%sort_abs ()
    pa2 = pa%sort_abs (unique = .true.)
    call pa1%write (u)
    write (u, *)
    call pa2%write (u)
    write (u, *)
    
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Compare"
    write (u, *)

    pa1 = [1, 3]
    pa2 = [1, 2, -2]
    pa3 = [1, 2, 4]
    pa4 = [1, 2, 4]
    pa5 = [1, 2, -4]
    pa6 = [1, 2, -3]
    
    write (u, "(A,6(1x,L1))")  "< ", &
         pa1 < pa2, pa2 < pa3, pa3 < pa4, pa4 < pa5, pa5 < pa6, pa6 < pa1
    write (u, "(A,6(1x,L1))")  "> ", &
         pa1 > pa2, pa2 > pa3, pa3 > pa4, pa4 > pa5, pa5 > pa6, pa6 > pa1
    write (u, "(A,6(1x,L1))")  "<=", &
         pa1 <= pa2, pa2 <= pa3, pa3 <= pa4, pa4 <= pa5, pa5 <= pa6, pa6 <= pa1
    write (u, "(A,6(1x,L1))")  ">=", &
         pa1 >= pa2, pa2 >= pa3, pa3 >= pa4, pa4 >= pa5, pa5 >= pa6, pa6 >= pa1
    write (u, "(A,6(1x,L1))")  "==", &
         pa1 == pa2, pa2 == pa3, pa3 == pa4, pa4 == pa5, pa5 == pa6, pa6 == pa1
    write (u, "(A,6(1x,L1))")  "/=", &
         pa1 /= pa2, pa2 /= pa3, pa3 /= pa4, pa4 /= pa5, pa5 /= pa6, pa6 /= pa1
   
    write (u, *)
    pa1 = [0]
    pa2 = [1, 2]
    pa3 = [1, -2]
    
    write (u, "(A,6(1x,L1))")  "eqv ", &
         pa1 .eqv. pa1, pa1 .eqv. pa2, &
         pa2 .eqv. pa2, pa2 .eqv. pa3
    
    write (u, "(A,6(1x,L1))")  "neqv", &
         pa1 .neqv. pa1, pa1 .neqv. pa2, &
         pa2 .neqv. pa2, pa2 .neqv. pa3
    

    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A,6(1x,L1))")  "match", &
         pa1 .match. 0, pa1 .match. 1, &
         pa2 .match. 0, pa2 .match. 1, pa2 .match. 3

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: pdg_arrays_1"        
    
  end subroutine pdg_arrays_1
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{246}PDG array list, i.e., arrays of arrays.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{247}\moddef{PDG arrays: execute tests}\plusendmoddef
  call test (pdg_arrays_2, "pdg_arrays_2", &
       "create and sort PDG lists", &
       u, results) 
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{248}\moddef{PDG arrays: tests}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_arrays_2 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u

    type(pdg_array_t) :: pa
    type(pdg_list_t) :: pl, pl1

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: pdg_arrays_2"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: create and sort PDG lists"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Assignment"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    call pl%init (3)
    call pl%set (1, 42)
    call pl%set (2, [3, 2])
    pa = [5, -5]
    call pl%set (3, pa)
    call pl%write (u)
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A,I0)")  "size = ", pl%get_size ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Sort"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    pl = pl%sort_abs ()
    call pl%write (u)
    write (u, *)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Extract item #3"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    pa = pl%get (3)
    call pa%write (u)
    write (u, *)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Replace item #3"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    call pl1%init (2)
    call pl1%set (1, [2, 4])
    call pl1%set (2, -7)
    
    pl = pl%replace (3, pl1)
    call pl%write (u)
    write (u, *)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: pdg_arrays_2"        
    
  end subroutine pdg_arrays_2
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{249}Check if a (sorted) PDG array lists is regular.  The entries (PDG arrays)
must not overlap, unless they are identical.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{250}\moddef{PDG arrays: execute tests}\plusendmoddef
  call test (pdg_arrays_3, "pdg_arrays_3", &
       "check PDG lists", &
       u, results) 
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{251}\moddef{PDG arrays: tests}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_arrays_3 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u

    type(pdg_list_t) :: pl

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: pdg_arrays_3"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: check for regular PDG lists"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Regular list"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    call pl%init (4)
    call pl%set (1, [1, 2])
    call pl%set (2, [1, 2])
    call pl%set (3, [5, -5])
    call pl%set (4, 42)
    call pl%write (u)
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(L1)") pl%is_regular ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Irregular list"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    call pl%init (4)
    call pl%set (1, [1, 2])
    call pl%set (2, [1, 2])
    call pl%set (3, [2, 5, -5])
    call pl%set (4, 42)
    call pl%write (u)
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(L1)") pl%is_regular ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: pdg_arrays_3"        
    
  end subroutine pdg_arrays_3
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{252}Compare PDG array lists.  The lists must be regular, i.e., sorted and with
non-overlapping (or identical) entries.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{253}\moddef{PDG arrays: execute tests}\plusendmoddef
  call test (pdg_arrays_4, "pdg_arrays_4", &
       "compare PDG lists", &
       u, results) 
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{254}\moddef{PDG arrays: tests}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_arrays_4 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u

    type(pdg_list_t) :: pl1, pl2, pl3

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: pdg_arrays_4"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: check for regular PDG lists"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Create lists"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    call pl1%init (4)
    call pl1%set (1, [1, 2])
    call pl1%set (2, [1, 2])
    call pl1%set (3, [5, -5])
    call pl1%set (4, 42)
    write (u, "(I1,1x)", advance = "no")  1
    call pl1%write (u)
    write (u, *)

    call pl2%init (2)
    call pl2%set (1, 3)
    call pl2%set (2, [5, -5])
    write (u, "(I1,1x)", advance = "no")  2
    call pl2%write (u)
    write (u, *)

    call pl3%init (2)
    call pl3%set (1, 4)
    call pl3%set (2, [5, -5])
    write (u, "(I1,1x)", advance = "no")  3
    call pl3%write (u)
    write (u, *)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* a == b"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    write (u, "(2x,A)")  "123"
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(I1,1x,4L1)")  1, pl1 == pl1, pl1 == pl2, pl1 == pl3
    write (u, "(I1,1x,4L1)")  2, pl2 == pl1, pl2 == pl2, pl2 == pl3
    write (u, "(I1,1x,4L1)")  3, pl3 == pl1, pl3 == pl2, pl3 == pl3

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* a < b"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    write (u, "(2x,A)")  "123"
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(I1,1x,4L1)")  1, pl1 < pl1, pl1 < pl2, pl1 < pl3
    write (u, "(I1,1x,4L1)")  2, pl2 < pl1, pl2 < pl2, pl2 < pl3
    write (u, "(I1,1x,4L1)")  3, pl3 < pl1, pl3 < pl2, pl3 < pl3

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: pdg_arrays_4"        
    
  end subroutine pdg_arrays_4
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{255}Match-replace: translate all entries in the first list into the
matching entries of the second list, if there is a match.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{256}\moddef{PDG arrays: execute tests}\plusendmoddef
  call test (pdg_arrays_5, "pdg_arrays_5", &
       "match PDG lists", &
       u, results) 
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{257}\moddef{PDG arrays: tests}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine pdg_arrays_5 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u

    type(pdg_list_t) :: pl1, pl2, pl3
    logical :: success

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: pdg_arrays_5"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: match-replace"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Create lists"
    write (u, "(A)")
    
    call pl1%init (2)
    call pl1%set (1, [1, 2])
    call pl1%set (2, 42)
    call pl1%write (u)
    write (u, *)
    call pl3%init (2)
    call pl3%set (1, [42, -42])
    call pl3%set (2, [1, 2, 3, 4])
    call pl1%match_replace (pl3, success)
    call pl3%write (u)
    write (u, "(1x,A,1x,L1,':',1x)", advance="no")  "=>", success
    call pl1%write (u)
    write (u, *)

    write (u, *)

    call pl2%init (2)
    call pl2%set (1, 9)
    call pl2%set (2, 42)
    call pl2%write (u)
    write (u, *)
    call pl2%match_replace (pl3, success)
    call pl3%write (u)
    write (u, "(1x,A,1x,L1,':',1x)", advance="no")  "=>", success
    call pl2%write (u)
    write (u, *)

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: pdg_arrays_5"        
    
  end subroutine pdg_arrays_5
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{258}\nwdocspar

\section{Jets}

also in a separate directory.  Here, we define \whizard-specific procedures
and tests.

module jets
    
\LA{}Use kinds\RA{}

  use fastjet !NODEP!
  
\LA{}Standard module head\RA{}

\LA{}Jets: public\RA{}

contains
  
\LA{}Jets: procedures\RA{}

\LA{}Jets: tests\RA{}

end module jets
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{260}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Re-exported symbols}
We use this module as a proxy for the FastJet interface, therefore we
re-export some symbols.

  subroutine fastjet_init ()
    call print_banner ()
  end subroutine fastjet_init
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{264}The jet algorithm codes (actually, integers)
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{265}\moddef{Jets: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: kt_algorithm
  public :: cambridge_algorithm
  public :: antikt_algorithm
  public :: genkt_algorithm
  public :: cambridge_for_passive_algorithm
  public :: genkt_for_passive_algorithm
  public :: ee_kt_algorithm
  public :: ee_genkt_algorithm
  public :: plugin_algorithm

\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{266}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Unit tests}
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{267}\moddef{Jets: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: jets_test 
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{268}\moddef{Jets: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine jets_test (u, results)
    integer, intent(in) :: u
    type (test_results_t), intent(inout) :: results
  \LA{}Jets: execute tests\RA{}  
  end subroutine jets_test

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{269}This test is actually the minimal example from the FastJet manual,
translated to Fortran.

Note that FastJet creates pseudojet vectors, which we mirror in the
{\tt{}pseudojet{\char95}vector{\char95}t}, but immediately assign to pseudojet arrays.  Without
automatic finalization available in the compilers, we should avoid this in
actual code and rather introduce intermediate variables for those objects,
which we can finalize explicitly.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{270}\moddef{Jets: execute tests}\endmoddef
  call test (jets_1, "jets_1", &
       "basic FastJet functionality", &
       u, results) 
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{271}\moddef{Jets: tests}\endmoddef
  subroutine jets_1 (u)
    integer, intent(in) :: u

    type(pseudojet_t), dimension(:), allocatable :: prt, jets, constituents
    type(jet_definition_t) :: jet_def
    type(cluster_sequence_t) :: cs

    integer, parameter :: dp = default
    integer :: i, j

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output: jets_1"
    write (u, "(A)")  "*   Purpose: test basic FastJet functionality"
    write (u, "(A)")    

    write (u, "(A)")  "* Print banner"
    call print_banner ()
    
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Prepare input particles"
    allocate (prt (3))
    call prt(1)%init ( 99._dp, 0.1_dp, 0._dp, 100._dp)
    call prt(2)%init (  4._dp,-0.1_dp, 0._dp,   5._dp)
    call prt(3)%init (-99._dp, 0._dp,  0._dp,  99._dp)

    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Define jet algorithm"
    call jet_def%init (antikt_algorithm, 0.7_dp)

    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cluster particles according to jet algorithm"

    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A,A)")  "Clustering with ", jet_def%description ()
    call cs%init (pseudojet_vector (prt), jet_def)

    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Sort output jets"
    jets = sorted_by_pt (cs%inclusive_jets ())

    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Print jet observables and constituents"
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(4x,3(7x,A3))") "pt", "y", "phi"
    do i = 1, size (jets)
       write (u, "(A,1x,I0,A,3(1x,F9.5))") &
            "jet", i, ":", jets(i)%perp (), jets(i)%rap (), jets(i)%phi ()
       constituents = jets(i)%constituents ()
       do j = 1, size (constituents)
          write (u, "(4x,A,1x,I0,A,F9.5)") &
               "constituent", j, "'s pt:", constituents(j)%perp ()
       end do
       do j = 1, size (constituents)
          call constituents(j)%final ()
       end do
    end do
    
    write (u, *)
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Cleanup"
    
    do i = 1, size (prt)
       call prt(i)%final ()
    end do
    do i = 1, size (jets)
       call jets(i)%final ()
    end do
    call jet_def%final ()
    call cs%final ()

    write (u, "(A)")
    write (u, "(A)")  "* Test output end: jets_1"        
    
  end subroutine jets_1
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{272}\nwdocspar
\clearpage

\section{Subevents}

The purpose of subevents is to store the relevant part of the physical
event (either partonic or hadronic), and to hold particle selections
and combinations which are constructed in cut or analysis expressions.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{273}\moddef{\code{}subevents.f90\edoc{}}\endmoddef
\LA{}File header\RA{}

module subevents

  use, intrinsic :: iso_c_binding !NODEP!
  
\LA{}Use kinds\RA{}
  use io_units
  use format_defs, only: FMT_14, FMT_19
  use format_utils, only: pac_fmt
  use sorting
  use c_particles
  use lorentz
  use pdg_arrays
  use jets

\LA{}Standard module head\RA{}

\LA{}Subevents: public\RA{}

\LA{}Subevents: parameters\RA{}

\LA{}Subevents: types\RA{}

\LA{}Subevents: interfaces\RA{}

contains

\LA{}Subevents: procedures\RA{}

end module subevents
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{274}\nwdocspar
\subsection{Particles}
For the purpose of this module, a particle has a type which can
indicate a beam, incoming, outgoing, or composite particle, flavor and
helicity codes (integer, undefined for composite), four-momentum and
invariant mass squared.  (Other particles types are used in extended
event types, but also defined here.)  Furthermore, each particle has
an allocatable array of ancestors -- particle indices which indicate
the building blocks of a composite particle.  For an incoming/outgoing
particle, the array contains only the index of the particle itself.

For incoming particles, the momentum is inverted before storing it in
the particle object.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{275}\moddef{Subevents: parameters}\endmoddef
  integer, parameter, public :: PRT_UNDEFINED = 0 
  integer, parameter, public :: PRT_BEAM = -9
  integer, parameter, public :: PRT_INCOMING = 1
  integer, parameter, public :: PRT_OUTGOING = 2
  integer, parameter, public :: PRT_COMPOSITE = 3
  integer, parameter, public :: PRT_VIRTUAL = 4
  integer, parameter, public :: PRT_RESONANT = 5
  integer, parameter, public :: PRT_BEAM_REMNANT = 9

\eatline
\eatline
\eatline
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{276}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{The type}
We initialize only the type here and mark as unpolarized.  The
initializers below do the rest.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{277}\moddef{Subevents: public}\endmoddef
  public :: prt_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{278}\moddef{Subevents: types}\endmoddef
  type :: prt_t
     private
     integer :: type = PRT_UNDEFINED
     integer :: pdg
     logical :: polarized = .false.
     integer :: h
     type(vector4_t) :: p
     real(default) :: p2
     integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: src
  end type prt_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{279}Initializers.  Polarization is set separately.  Finalizers are not
needed.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{280}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\endmoddef
  subroutine prt_init_beam (prt, pdg, p, p2, src)
    type(prt_t), intent(out) :: prt
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg
    type(vector4_t), intent(in) :: p
    real(default), intent(in) :: p2
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: src
    prt%type = PRT_BEAM
    call prt_set (prt, pdg, - p, p2, src)
  end subroutine prt_init_beam
    
  subroutine prt_init_incoming (prt, pdg, p, p2, src)
    type(prt_t), intent(out) :: prt
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg
    type(vector4_t), intent(in) :: p
    real(default), intent(in) :: p2
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: src
    prt%type = PRT_INCOMING
    call prt_set (prt, pdg, - p, p2, src)
  end subroutine prt_init_incoming
    
  subroutine prt_init_outgoing (prt, pdg, p, p2, src)
    type(prt_t), intent(out) :: prt
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg
    type(vector4_t), intent(in) :: p
    real(default), intent(in) :: p2
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: src
    prt%type = PRT_OUTGOING
    call prt_set (prt, pdg, p, p2, src)
  end subroutine prt_init_outgoing
    
  subroutine prt_init_composite (prt, p, src)
    type(prt_t), intent(out) :: prt
    type(vector4_t), intent(in) :: p
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: src
    prt%type = PRT_COMPOSITE
    call prt_set (prt, 0, p, p**2, src)
  end subroutine prt_init_composite

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{281}\nwdocspar
This version is for temporary particle objects, so the {\tt{}src} array
is not set.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{282}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: prt_init_combine
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{283}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine prt_init_combine (prt, prt1, prt2)
    type(prt_t), intent(out) :: prt
    type(prt_t), intent(in) :: prt1, prt2
    type(vector4_t) :: p
    integer, dimension(0) :: src
    prt%type = PRT_COMPOSITE
    p = prt1%p + prt2%p
    call prt_set (prt, 0, p, p**2, src)
  end subroutine prt_init_combine

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{284}Init from a pseudojet object.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{285}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine prt_init_pseudojet (prt, jet, src)
    type(prt_t), intent(out) :: prt
    type(pseudojet_t), intent(in) :: jet
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: src
    type(vector4_t) :: p
    prt%type = PRT_COMPOSITE
    p = vector4_moving (jet%e(), &
         vector3_moving ([jet%px(), jet%py(), jet%pz()]))
    call prt_set (prt, 0, p, p**2, src)
  end subroutine prt_init_pseudojet
  
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{286}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Accessing contents}
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{287}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: prt_get_pdg
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{288}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental function prt_get_pdg (prt) result (pdg)
    integer :: pdg
    type(prt_t), intent(in) :: prt
    pdg = prt%pdg
  end function prt_get_pdg

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{289}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef

\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{290}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental function prt_get_momentum (prt) result (p)
    type(vector4_t) :: p
    type(prt_t), intent(in) :: prt
    p = prt%p
  end function prt_get_momentum

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{291}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: prt_get_msq
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{292}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental function prt_get_msq (prt) result (msq)
    real(default) :: msq
    type(prt_t), intent(in) :: prt
    msq = prt%p2
  end function prt_get_msq

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{293}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: prt_is_polarized
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{294}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental function prt_is_polarized (prt) result (flag)
    logical :: flag
    type(prt_t), intent(in) :: prt
    flag = prt%polarized
  end function prt_is_polarized

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{295}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: prt_get_helicity
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{296}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental function prt_get_helicity (prt) result (h)
    integer :: h
    type(prt_t), intent(in) :: prt
    h = prt%h
  end function prt_get_helicity

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{297}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Setting data}
Set the PDG, momentum and momentum squared, and ancestors.  If
allocate-on-assignment is available, this can be simplified.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{298}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine prt_set (prt, pdg, p, p2, src)
    type(prt_t), intent(inout) :: prt
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg
    type(vector4_t), intent(in) :: p
    real(default), intent(in) :: p2
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: src
    prt%pdg = pdg
    prt%p = p
    prt%p2 = p2
    if (allocated (prt%src)) then
       if (size (src) /= size (prt%src)) then
          deallocate (prt%src)
          allocate (prt%src (size (src)))
       end if
    else
       allocate (prt%src (size (src)))
    end if
    prt%src = src
  end subroutine prt_set

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{299}Set the particle PDG code separately.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{300}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental subroutine prt_set_pdg (prt, pdg)
    type(prt_t), intent(inout) :: prt
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg
    prt%pdg = pdg
  end subroutine prt_set_pdg

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{301}Set the momentum separately.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{302}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental subroutine prt_set_p (prt, p)
    type(prt_t), intent(inout) :: prt
    type(vector4_t), intent(in) :: p
    prt%p = p
  end subroutine prt_set_p

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{303}Set the squared invariant mass separately.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{304}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental subroutine prt_set_p2 (prt, p2)
    type(prt_t), intent(inout) :: prt
    real(default), intent(in) :: p2
    prt%p2 = p2
  end subroutine prt_set_p2

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{305}Set helicity (optional).
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{306}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine prt_polarize (prt, h)
    type(prt_t), intent(inout) :: prt
    integer, intent(in) :: h
    prt%polarized = .true.
    prt%h = h
  end subroutine prt_polarize

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{307}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Conversion}
Transform a {\tt{}prt{\char95}t} object into a {\tt{}c{\char95}prt{\char95}t} object.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{308}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: c_prt
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{309}\moddef{Subevents: interfaces}\endmoddef
  interface c_prt
     module procedure c_prt_from_prt
  end interface

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{310}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental function c_prt_from_prt (prt) result (c_prt)
    type(c_prt_t) :: c_prt
    type(prt_t), intent(in) :: prt
    c_prt%type = prt%type
    c_prt%pdg = prt%pdg
    if (prt%polarized) then
       c_prt%polarized = 1
    else
       c_prt%polarized = 0
    end if
    c_prt%h = prt%h
    c_prt%pe = energy (prt%p)
    c_prt%px = vector4_get_component (prt%p, 1)
    c_prt%py = vector4_get_component (prt%p, 2)
    c_prt%pz = vector4_get_component (prt%p, 3)
    c_prt%p2 = prt%p2
  end function c_prt_from_prt

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{311}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Output}
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{312}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: prt_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{313}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine prt_write (prt, unit, pacified)
    type(prt_t), intent(in) :: prt
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    logical, intent(in), optional :: pacified
    real(default), dimension(0:3) :: arr
    logical :: num_pac
    type(prt_t) :: tmp
    character(len=7) :: fmt   
    integer :: u, i
    call pac_fmt (fmt, FMT_19, FMT_14, pacified)
    u = given_output_unit (unit);  if (u < 0)  return
    num_pac = .false. ; if (present (pacified))  num_pac = pacified
    write (u, "(1x,A)", advance="no")  "prt("
    select case (prt%type)
    case (PRT_UNDEFINED);    write (u, "('?')", advance="no")
    case (PRT_BEAM);         write (u, "('b:')", advance="no")
    case (PRT_INCOMING);     write (u, "('i:')", advance="no")
    case (PRT_OUTGOING);     write (u, "('o:')", advance="no")
    case (PRT_COMPOSITE);    write (u, "('c:')", advance="no")
    end select
    select case (prt%type)
    case (PRT_BEAM, PRT_INCOMING, PRT_OUTGOING)
       if (prt%polarized) then
          write (u, "(I0,'/',I0,'|')", advance="no")  prt%pdg, prt%h
       else
          write (u, "(I0,'|')", advance="no") prt%pdg
       end if
    end select
    select case (prt%type)
    case (PRT_BEAM, PRT_INCOMING, PRT_OUTGOING, PRT_COMPOSITE)
       tmp = prt
       if (num_pac) then
          call pacify (tmp)
       end if
       arr = tmp%p
       write (u, "(" // FMT_14 // ",';'," // FMT_14 // ",','," // &
            FMT_14 // ",','," // FMT_14 // ")", advance="no") arr
       write (u, "('|'," // fmt // ")", advance="no") &
            tmp%p2
    end select
    if (allocated (prt%src)) then
       write (u, "('|')", advance="no")
       do i = 1, size (prt%src)
          write (u, "(1x,I0)", advance="no")  prt%src(i)
       end do
    end if
    write (u, "(A)")  ")"
  end subroutine prt_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{314}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Tools}
Two particles match if their {\tt{}src} arrays are the same.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{315}\moddef{Subevents: interfaces}\plusendmoddef
  interface operator(.match.)
     module procedure prt_match
  end interface

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{316}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  elemental function prt_match (prt1, prt2) result (match)
    logical :: match
    type(prt_t), intent(in) :: prt1, prt2
    if (size (prt1%src) == size (prt2%src)) then
       match = all (prt1%src == prt2%src)
    else
       match = .false.
    end if
  end function prt_match

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{317}The combine operation makes a pseudoparticle whose momentum is the
result of adding (the momenta of) the pair of input particles.  We
trace the particles from which a particle is built by storing a
{\tt{}src} array.  Each particle entry in the {\tt{}src} list contains a
list of indices which indicates its building blocks.  The indices
refer to an original list of particles.  Index lists are sorted, and
they contain no element more than once.

We thus require that in a given pseudoparticle, each original particle
occurs at most once.

The result is intent(inout), so it will not be initialized when the
subroutine is entered.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{318}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine prt_combine (prt, prt_in1, prt_in2, ok)
    type(prt_t), intent(inout) :: prt
    type(prt_t), intent(in) :: prt_in1, prt_in2
    logical :: ok
    integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: src
    call combine_index_lists (src, prt_in1%src, prt_in2%src)
    ok = allocated (src)
    if (ok)  call prt_init_composite (prt, prt_in1%p + prt_in2%p, src)
  end subroutine prt_combine

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{319}This variant does not produce the combined particle, it just checks
whether the combination is valid (no common {\tt{}src} entry).
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{320}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: are_disjoint
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{321}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function are_disjoint (prt_in1, prt_in2) result (flag)
    logical :: flag
    type(prt_t), intent(in) :: prt_in1, prt_in2
    flag = index_lists_are_disjoint (prt_in1%src, prt_in2%src)
  end function are_disjoint

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{322}{\tt{}src} Lists with length $>1$ are built by a {\tt{}combine} operation
which merges the lists in a sorted manner.  If the result would have a
duplicate entry, it is discarded, and the result is unallocated.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{323}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine combine_index_lists (res, src1, src2)
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: src1, src2
    integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: res
    integer :: i1, i2, i
    allocate (res (size (src1) + size (src2)))
    if (size (src1) == 0) then
       res = src2
       return
    else if (size (src2) == 0) then
       res = src1
       return
    end if
    i1 = 1
    i2 = 1
    LOOP: do i = 1, size (res)
       if (src1(i1) < src2(i2)) then
          res(i) = src1(i1);  i1 = i1 + 1
          if (i1 > size (src1)) then
             res(i+1:) = src2(i2:)
             exit LOOP
          end if
       else if (src1(i1) > src2(i2)) then
          res(i) = src2(i2);  i2 = i2 + 1
          if (i2 > size (src2)) then
             res(i+1:) = src1(i1:)
             exit LOOP
          end if
       else
          deallocate (res)
          exit LOOP
       end if
    end do LOOP
  end subroutine combine_index_lists

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{324}This function is similar, but it does not actually merge the list,
it just checks whether they are disjoint (no common {\tt{}src} entry).
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{325}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function index_lists_are_disjoint (src1, src2) result (flag)
    logical :: flag
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: src1, src2
    integer :: i1, i2, i
    flag = .true.
    i1 = 1
    i2 = 1
    LOOP: do i = 1, size (src1) + size (src2)
       if (src1(i1) < src2(i2)) then
          i1 = i1 + 1
          if (i1 > size (src1)) then
             exit LOOP
          end if
       else if (src1(i1) > src2(i2)) then
          i2 = i2 + 1
          if (i2 > size (src2)) then
             exit LOOP
          end if
       else
          flag = .false.
          exit LOOP
       end if
    end do LOOP
  end function index_lists_are_disjoint

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{326}\nwdocspar
\subsection{subevents}
Particles are collected in subevents.  This type is implemented as a
dynamically allocated array, which need not be completely filled.  The
value {\tt{}n{\char95}active} determines the number of meaningful entries.

\subsubsection{Type definition}
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{327}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: subevt_t
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{328}\moddef{Subevents: types}\plusendmoddef
  type :: subevt_t
     private
     integer :: n_active = 0
     type(prt_t), dimension(:), allocatable :: prt
   contains
   \LA{}Subevents: subevt: TBP\RA{}
  end type subevt_t

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{329}Initialize, allocating with size zero (default) or given size.  The
number of contained particles is set equal to the size.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{330}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: subevt_init
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{331}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine subevt_init (subevt, n_active)
    type(subevt_t), intent(out) :: subevt
    integer, intent(in), optional :: n_active
    if (present (n_active))  subevt%n_active = n_active
    allocate (subevt%prt (subevt%n_active))
  end subroutine subevt_init

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{332}(Re-)allocate the subevent with some given size.  If the size
is greater than the previous one, do a real reallocation.  Otherwise,
just reset the recorded size. Contents are untouched, but become
invalid.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{333}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: subevt_reset
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{334}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine subevt_reset (subevt, n_active)
    type(subevt_t), intent(inout) :: subevt
    integer, intent(in) :: n_active
    subevt%n_active = n_active
    if (subevt%n_active > size (subevt%prt)) then
       deallocate (subevt%prt)
       allocate (subevt%prt (subevt%n_active))
    end if
  end subroutine subevt_reset

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{335}Output.  No prefix for the headline 'subevt', because this will usually be
printed appending to a previous line.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{336}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: subevt_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{337}\moddef{Subevents: subevt: TBP}\endmoddef
  procedure :: write => subevt_write
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{338}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine subevt_write (object, unit, prefix, pacified)
    class(subevt_t), intent(in) :: object
    integer, intent(in), optional :: unit
    character(*), intent(in), optional :: prefix
    logical, intent(in), optional :: pacified
    integer :: u, i
    u = given_output_unit (unit);  if (u < 0)  return
    write (u, "(1x,A)") "subevent:"
    do i = 1, object%n_active
       if (present (prefix))  write (u, "(A)", advance="no") prefix
       write (u, "(1x,I0)", advance="no")  i
       call prt_write (object%prt(i), unit = unit, pacified = pacified)
    end do
  end subroutine subevt_write

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{339}Defined assignment: transfer only meaningful entries.  This is a
deep copy (as would be default assignment).
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{340}\moddef{Subevents: interfaces}\plusendmoddef
  interface assignment(=)
     module procedure subevt_assign
  end interface

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{341}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine subevt_assign (subevt, subevt_in)
    type(subevt_t), intent(inout) :: subevt
    type(subevt_t), intent(in) :: subevt_in
    if (.not. allocated (subevt%prt)) then
       call subevt_init (subevt, subevt_in%n_active)
    else
       call subevt_reset (subevt, subevt_in%n_active)
    end if
    subevt%prt(:subevt%n_active) = subevt_in%prt(:subevt%n_active)
  end subroutine subevt_assign

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{342}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Fill contents}
Store incoming/outgoing particles which are completely defined.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{343}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: subevt_set_beam
  public :: subevt_set_incoming
  public :: subevt_set_outgoing
  public :: subevt_set_composite
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{344}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine subevt_set_beam (subevt, i, pdg, p, p2, src)
    type(subevt_t), intent(inout) :: subevt
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg
    type(vector4_t), intent(in) :: p
    real(default), intent(in) :: p2
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in), optional :: src
    if (present (src)) then
       call prt_init_beam (subevt%prt(i), pdg, p, p2, src)
    else
       call prt_init_beam (subevt%prt(i), pdg, p, p2, [i])
    end if
  end subroutine subevt_set_beam

  subroutine subevt_set_incoming (subevt, i, pdg, p, p2, src)
    type(subevt_t), intent(inout) :: subevt
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg
    type(vector4_t), intent(in) :: p
    real(default), intent(in) :: p2
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in), optional :: src
    if (present (src)) then
       call prt_init_incoming (subevt%prt(i), pdg, p, p2, src)
    else
       call prt_init_incoming (subevt%prt(i), pdg, p, p2, [i])
    end if
  end subroutine subevt_set_incoming

  subroutine subevt_set_outgoing (subevt, i, pdg, p, p2, src)
    type(subevt_t), intent(inout) :: subevt
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, intent(in) :: pdg
    type(vector4_t), intent(in) :: p
    real(default), intent(in) :: p2
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in), optional :: src
    if (present (src)) then
       call prt_init_outgoing (subevt%prt(i), pdg, p, p2, src)
    else
       call prt_init_outgoing (subevt%prt(i), pdg, p, p2, [i])
    end if
  end subroutine subevt_set_outgoing

  subroutine subevt_set_composite (subevt, i, p, src)
    type(subevt_t), intent(inout) :: subevt
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    type(vector4_t), intent(in) :: p
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: src
    call prt_init_composite (subevt%prt(i), p, src)
  end subroutine subevt_set_composite

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{345}Separately assign flavors, simultaneously for all incoming/outgoing
particles.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{346}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: subevt_set_pdg_beam
  public :: subevt_set_pdg_incoming
  public :: subevt_set_pdg_outgoing
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{347}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine subevt_set_pdg_beam (subevt, pdg)
    type(subevt_t), intent(inout) :: subevt
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: pdg
    integer :: i, j
    j = 1
    do i = 1, subevt%n_active
       if (subevt%prt(i)%type == PRT_BEAM) then
          call prt_set_pdg (subevt%prt(i), pdg(j))
          j = j + 1
          if (j > size (pdg))  exit
       end if
    end do
  end subroutine subevt_set_pdg_beam

  subroutine subevt_set_pdg_incoming (subevt, pdg)
    type(subevt_t), intent(inout) :: subevt
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: pdg
    integer :: i, j
    j = 1
    do i = 1, subevt%n_active
       if (subevt%prt(i)%type == PRT_INCOMING) then
          call prt_set_pdg (subevt%prt(i), pdg(j))
          j = j + 1
          if (j > size (pdg))  exit
       end if
    end do
  end subroutine subevt_set_pdg_incoming

  subroutine subevt_set_pdg_outgoing (subevt, pdg)
    type(subevt_t), intent(inout) :: subevt
    integer, dimension(:), intent(in) :: pdg
    integer :: i, j
    j = 1
    do i = 1, subevt%n_active
       if (subevt%prt(i)%type == PRT_OUTGOING) then
          call prt_set_pdg (subevt%prt(i), pdg(j))
          j = j + 1
          if (j > size (pdg))  exit
       end if
    end do
  end subroutine subevt_set_pdg_outgoing

\eatline
\eatline
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{348}Separately assign momenta, simultaneously for all incoming/outgoing
particles.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{349}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: subevt_set_p_beam
  public :: subevt_set_p_incoming
  public :: subevt_set_p_outgoing
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{350}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef

    type(subevt_t), intent(inout) :: subevt
    type(vector4_t), dimension(:), intent(in) :: p
    integer :: i, j
    j = 1

       if (subevt%prt(i)%type == PRT_INCOMING) then

\eatline
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{351}Separately assign the squared invariant mass, simultaneously for all

  public :: subevt_set_p2_beam

\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{354}Set polarization for an entry

  public :: subevt_polarize
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{356}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  subroutine subevt_polarize (subevt, i, h)
    type(subevt_t), intent(inout) :: subevt

    call prt_polarize (subevt%prt(i), h)
  end subroutine subevt_polarize

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{357}\nwdocspar
\subsubsection{Accessing contents}
Return true if the subevent has entries.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{358}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: subevt_is_nonempty
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{359}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function subevt_is_nonempty (subevt) result (flag)
    logical :: flag
    type(subevt_t), intent(in) :: subevt
    flag = subevt%n_active /= 0
  end function subevt_is_nonempty

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{360}Return the number of entries
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{361}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: subevt_get_length
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{362}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function subevt_get_length (subevt) result (length)
    integer :: length
    type(subevt_t), intent(in) :: subevt
    length = subevt%n_active
  end function subevt_get_length

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{363}Return a specific particle.  The index is not checked for validity.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{364}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: subevt_get_prt
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{365}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function subevt_get_prt (subevt, i) result (prt)
    type(prt_t) :: prt
    type(subevt_t), intent(in) :: subevt
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    prt = subevt%prt(i)
  end function subevt_get_prt

\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{366}Return the partonic energy squared.  We take the particles with flag
{\tt{}PRT{\char95}INCOMING} and compute their total invariant mass.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{367}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: subevt_get_sqrts_hat
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{368}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function subevt_get_sqrts_hat (subevt) result (sqrts_hat)
    type(subevt_t), intent(in) :: subevt
    real(default) :: sqrts_hat
    type(vector4_t) :: p
    integer :: i
    do i = 1, subevt%n_active
       if (subevt%prt(i)%type == PRT_INCOMING) then
          p = p + prt_get_momentum (subevt%prt(i))
       end if
    end do
    sqrts_hat = p ** 1
  end function subevt_get_sqrts_hat
    
\eatline
\nwendcode{}\nwbegindocs{369}Return the number of incoming (outgoing) particles, respectively.
Beam particles or composites are not counted.
\nwenddocs{}\nwbegincode{370}\moddef{Subevents: public}\plusendmoddef
  public :: subevt_get_n_in
  public :: subevt_get_n_out
\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{371}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
  function subevt_get_n_in (subevt) result (n_in)
    type(subevt_t), intent(in) :: subevt
    integer :: n_in
    n_in = count (subevt%prt(:subevt%n_active)%type == PRT_INCOMING)
  end function subevt_get_n_in
    
  function subevt_get_n_out (subevt) result (n_out)
    type(subevt_t), intent(in) :: subevt
    integer :: n_out
    n_out = count (subevt%prt(:subevt%n_active)%type == PRT_OUTGOING)
  end function subevt_get_n_out
    
\eatline
\eatline

\nwendcode{}\nwbegincode{374}\moddef{Subevents: procedures}\plusendmoddef
